tools.name: market_list
tools.description: Find supported SuperCheap country, language, currency, and checkout availability combinations.

tools.name: category_search
tools.description: Find canonical SuperCheap categories using lexical and semantic matching.

tools.name: category_get_tree
tools.description: Return a bounded category subtree. Use rootCategoryId and maxDepth to avoid loading the entire taxonomy.

tools.name: catalog_report_product_impressions
tools.description: Record only products that were actually presented to the shopper. Searching alone does not mark products as viewed. This idempotent impression signal is used to demote or exclude products in later searches.

tools.name: catalog_get_product

tools.name: catalog_get_existing_product
tools.description: Read one already-published canonical catalog product by its exact itemId. This performs a direct catalog lookup only; it does not search suppliers, hydrate supplier details, request enrichment, or start translation work. Returns the canonical product link and immutable first-party product image URL

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "catalog_search_products" is 2195 chars, far longer than this server's median (264). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
